title: The Real Sparky Sparkswall
summary: Shield with +2 AC and a Lightning Charge-powered aura.

fields.Lightning Aura: Action once per Long Rest. Consume 3 Lightning Charges. Nearby enemies in a 20 ft radius take 1d6 Lightning, with DC 13 Dexterity save. Aura lasts 3 turns.
fields.Jolted: Enemies starting turns in the aura take 1d4 Lightning automatically and cannot spend the Reaction resource. Leaving the aura ends it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
